title: Avoid spreading reducer accumulators
why: Spreading an accumulator copies every value collected so far on each reduction step, turning linear accumulation into quadratic copying.
suggestion: Mutate a locally owned accumulator with push, assignment, or Object.assign, or use a construction API that does not repeatedly copy prior results.
limitations: Only arrow-function reducers whose accumulator is a simple identifier are reported.
Custom reduce implementations, reducer size, and cases that intentionally preserve immutable intermediate values are not inferred.
